criteria.name: decision_scope
criteria.criterion: Diagnostic retrospective transfer only, post-pilot decision with real date; no R3 or recovered blindness.

criteria.name: pilot_gate
criteria.criterion: The original2percent criterion remains failed; no implicit scientific-go for unchanged full-recipe confirmation.

criteria.name: all_recipes
criteria.criterion: All five frozen neural recipes and all three final seeds are listed before forecasts; no best-seed/recipe cherry-picking.

criteria.name: checkpoint_identity
criteria.criterion: Each final checkpoint is fixed by source commit, artifact path, stage, recipe, seed and SHA256; not confused with HPO checkpoint.

criteria.name: analytic_controls
criteria.criterion: Both analytic controls fixed; fit-mean excess comes from the prior BTC fit, not recomputed on additional datasets.

criteria.name: data_identity
criteria.criterion: D01,D02,D03 admission hashes and original clean_test role/date/window sets fixed; no exclusion based on result.

criteria.name: preprocessing
criteria.criterion: BTC feature and target scales held fixed; no fitting, HPO, fine-tuning, recalibration or target-domain normalization.

criteria.name: input_information
criteria.criterion: Only origin-available OHLCV and A go into forward; U/Y remain labels; sigma7 population ddof0.

criteria.name: units_shift
criteria.criterion: Covariate units and target definition recorded, especially COIN-M contracts volume vs spot/equity volume; no post-result conversion to improve score.

criteria.name: comparison_scope
criteria.criterion: Within fixed BTC-trained recipes/control comparison; no fairness claim against domain-fitted796job models.

criteria.name: outputs
criteria.criterion: Predictions, finite errors, counts, failures and all descriptive metrics kept; dates are not iid replicas.

criteria.name: statistics
criteria.criterion: No p-values, confidence declarations, selected metric switching or confirmatory superiority claims; three-seed dispersion is descriptive.

criteria.name: uncertainty
criteria.criterion: No additive-service calibrator inherited by V3; no calibrated forecast-distribution claim.

criteria.name: publication_order
criteria.criterion: Root publishes exact decision/plan in a real Git commit before new diagnostic forwards and preserves commit/hash receipt.

criteria.name: execution_tally
criteria.criterion: New diagnostic forwards/predictions recorded separately from engineering parity/reproduction; no global zero-new-predictions claim.

criteria.name: no_model_changes
criteria.criterion: Weights, learned scalers,losslambda and head definitions untouched; export lowering treated as backend conversion, not new design.

criteria.name: failure_policy
criteria.criterion: Systematic nonfinite/contract failures stop or mark affected predefined outputs without dropping inconvenient observations; no invented zeros.

criteria.name: final_labels
criteria.criterion: Completed diagnostic does not mean V3 confirmatory validation, R3 accreditation, production promotion or independent human reproduction.
